note: Bundled locally with the package release. The 'approved' status indicates approval under CryptoFlex's bundled local algorithm policy only; it does not indicate government, regulatory, standards-body, or independent third-party certification. Updated by maintainers as new guidance is published. No network calls are made.

x25519.notes: Well-audited classical ECDH. Not quantum-resistant; retained in hybrid profiles for defense-in-depth against undiscovered PQC flaws.

mlkem768.notes: NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768). Recommended default PQC component as of table_version 2026.08.1.

mlkem1024.notes: NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-1024). Higher security margin, larger keys/ciphertexts, more compute.
